target.title: feat(gateway): include produced messageId on chat final/aborted events
target.body:
## What

Adds an optional, stable `messageId` to the Gateway `final` and `aborted` chat events, carrying the transcript id of the assistant message the run produced.

Closes #105593.

## Why

Today `final` carries only `runId`, `sessionKey`, `state` — nothing about *what* the run produced. External clients (e.g. the Open WebUI pipe) have to re-fetch the transcript and guess "the last assistant message", which is decoupled from the run and causes duplicate proactive deliveries: a background run (heartbeat/sub-agent/yield) ends with a contentless `final`, the client re-ships the transcript tail under a new `runId`, and the same message gets persisted twice.

With `messageId` on the event, clients can dedup on `(sessionKey, messageId)` deterministically.

## Changes

- `packages/gateway-protocol`: add optional `messageId` to `ChatFinalEventSchema` and `ChatAbortedEventSchema` (`additionalProperties: false` preserved).
- `src/gateway/server-chat.ts`: thread the produced `messageId` through the agent-event handler onto the emitted final/aborted payload.
- `src/gateway/server-methods/chat.ts`: populate `messageId` from the appended message on the synchronous final payload.
- Tests in `server.agent.gateway-server-agent-b.test.ts`.

## Compatibility

Fully additive and backward-compatible — the field is optional; existing clients that ignore it are unaffected.

## Verification

- Rebased on latest `main`.
- Targeted gateway tests pass locally (`server.agent.gateway-server-agent-b.test.ts` + sibling shard: 32/32). Full repo typecheck/test left to CI.
